snippet.title: Basketball Classics – #PlayAcclaim | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
PURCHASE NOW on PC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/819630/Basketball_Classics/

Welcome to Basketball Classics! A retro-inspired, side-scrolling 5-on-5 basketball experience that blends arcade thrills with modern play-calling and easy three-button controls.

The latest entry in our Acclaim Sports Classics collection of Games!!!

What to Expect:

• Arcade-Style Hoop Action – Quick gameplay with depth, where every possession counts.
• Retro Vibes, Modern Depth – Hundreds of teams, over 1,000 unique players, and unlockable legends.
• Multiple Modes – Quick Play, Season, and Story modes, all designed for endless replay.
• Chaotic Local Multiplayer – Couch competition at its finest, buzzer-beaters guaranteed.
• True Indie Spirit – No pay-to-win mechanics, just authentic retro basketball made with passion.

Basketball Classics is available now on Steam for PC & Coming Soon to Home Console
